# OCS2 legged robot example: why does the green target body trajectory drift upward after multiple forward and backward movements?

> **Current answer:** The thread explanation states that dummy simulation and MPC use the same model, and the zero-velocity contact constraint is used to maintain contact. Long-term integration accumulates drift. Commands are still published in the world frame, but the internal ground awareness has drifted along the z-axis, so the green trajectory appears to rise. The thread only mentions that the formal terrain notion will be added in the future, and no reproducible patch was provided at the time.
